gui_forms::Label.summary: Label is a noninteractive retained text primitive with inherited typography roles, explicit font/color overrides, horizontal and vertical alignment, word wrapping, bounded line count, line spacing, mnemonics, and static-text semantics.
remarks: Text, horizontal and vertical alignment, wrapping, bounded line count, and line spacing are retained; `text_changed` is synchronous outside an initialization transaction.

`TextStyleRole` selects inherited body, control, caption, heading, title, or monospace typography from the active theme. Font and foreground are independently overridable; `clear_font()` and `clear_foreground()` restore theme authority.
`use_mnemonic` applies the portable ampersand contract to measure, paint, semantic text, and next-selectable-control focus. The label does not intercept hit testing.
gui_forms::Label.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::Label.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::Label.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
